_comment: Surround locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, best to worst); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Player Surround pada grid {width}x{height}.
Anda adalah pemain {player_id}. Gerakan yang valid: '[up]' '[down]' '[left]' '[right]' atau w/s/a/d.
Tujuan: bertahan hidup lebih lama dari yang lain. Jejak-jejak berbahaya; tabrakan dinding mematikan; tabrakan kepala-ke-kepala membunuh keduanya.

outcome.all_crashed: Sininna tau maccule'e nasolang maneng secara massamang.
outcome.outlived: Pelaenng e lebbi tuo pole ri laingnge.
outcome.turn_limit: Watang giliranna lettu - tau kaminang malampe'e tuwo naalai.
